content: Bab-Dummad Igar-Mesisad gannar obinosad

Moisés Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “Deun a-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová anga sokalid: ‘Igi iduar be akwa matabo sobsagusa, deyobi, be gannar sobbalo. Deginbali, urgo-ulu be sobbalo. Geb a-sorbali, anse yar-birse be nakwedago.
Igi akwa-matabogwad-idualed-be-marisgusadgi narmaklesgusa, deyobi, akwa-matabogwadgi an gannar narmakoed. Geb degine, we-akwa-matabogwad ulu-yagi be mesoed.’
”Geb degine, an acacia-urgogi ulu-sobsad. Deginbali, akwa-iduar-soblesadyob akwa matabo an imaksabalid. Geb degine, we-akwa-matabogwad an-argangi-gani an yar-birse nakwide gusad.

Epenne, bemar danar-bukwagusmargu, Bab-Jehová yar-birgi soo-gwabunyemaid-abalagi sunmaksagusadgi, Igar-sogambegwad-narmaklesad (10) anga uksa-gusad. Ar Bab-Jehová igi iduar we-Igar-Sogambegwad (10) akwa-matabogwadgi narmaksagusa, deyob, we-Igar-bemarga-ukega gannar narmaksabalid. Geb anga uksa gusad.

”Geb agi, an gannar aligusad, an yar-birgi-gudii aidealid. Geb, we-akwa-matargwagwad an Ulu-sobsad-yagi mesisad. Emide, amba a-akwa-matabogwad, a-Uluyagi maid. Bab-Jehová-anga-Igar-uksagusadba imaklesad.”
Levita-dulemar-e-arbaed

Moisés, Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “A-sorbali, bemar Beerot-Bene-Jaacánʼgi ainiar gusmalad. Geb Moseraʼye-neg-nugadse modapmalad. Agi Aarón burgwisad, agi diglesbalid. Geb e-machi-Eleazar, e-bab-Aarón-sorba, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-e-gan sunonikid.
Geb agine, bemar Gudgodaʼye-neg-nugadse nadegusmarbalid. Geb Gudgoda-akar Jotbataʼye-neg-nugadse nadmarbalid. Agi dianmar-bukidar-nikad-negad.

A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová Leví-wagan-susa gusad, adi, Bab-Jehová-Israel-Dulemarbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu seega, Bab-Jehová-asabin-gudii guega, ega-arbadii guega, Bab-Dummad-nuggi dulemar-baigangi ise-nued binsaegar. Emi-ibagi imakdimaladyob.
A-ulale, Leví-waganga e-gwenadgan-abargine, nainu ega uklegosulid, ar ade, Bab-Jehová e-sunnad Leví-wagangadga gunonikid.
”An igi-gebe-yar-birgi gudigusa, deyobi, an bane-bane iba-dulabo (40) an Bab-Jehováʼse gordii gusbalid. Bab-Jehová amba an-itononibalid, agi, bar bemar-ogilobi gussulid.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová anga sokalid: ‘Be nae. Dulemar-idu be guakwaa nadap-imako, adi, be-dadganga-an-yar-ukoye-sogsadse be dogmalagar, a-yala bemargadga guegar.’ ”
Bab-Dummad weyob ibmar-imaked abeged
Moisés Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “Israel-dulemar, emigindi, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, ¿ar ibu-ibmar-imakbi bemar-abe be insae?
”Ar nibneg-naid, nibneg-bur-birigined-naid, napneg-naid, degi, bela agi-ibmar-bukwadi, Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼgadbiid.

Ar Bab-Jehová dule-bamalad-suewilubbinad, degi-inigwele, bemar-dadgangi unnila ataksad, amarbi-sabgusad. Ar bemarde, e-wagan-gumarsoggu, igi emi anmar bukwa, deyobi, dulemar-bamalad-akar-akar-bukmalad-abargi be-sunonimarmogad.
”Degisoggu, be-gwagegi na be sogmarsun, Bab-Dummadgarbi an gudii guoye. Melle be uyasuli damar.

Ar ade, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, bab-dummaganba bur Bab-Dummadid, degine, dule-dummaganba bur-Dummadid. Bab-Jehová bur dule-dummadid, bur dule-dutusulidid, bela dulemar dobdamalad. Bab-Jehová bela dulemar-emarbi-daked, degine, dule-baiganse geg manigi binsaed-galeged.
Mimmigan-sergan-satedga, degi, ome-ei-sui-burgwismaladga, igar-innikigwad imaked. Degine, dule-ainebarmaladga e-sabed oyoged, ega mas ukdaed, degi, mor ukdabalid.
Degisoggu, bemar-abargi dule-ainebalid-gudiid be sabguo, ar Egipto-yargi be gudigusmargu, deyob be gusmarmogad.

”Be-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼba be ibsadii nanao, e-nug-odummodii be guo, asebi be gordii guo, aba be nanadii guo. Ar be, ibmar-ise-sogar-sogbidibe, Bab-Dummad-nuggi innikigwadba an ise-sogar-sogye, an deyob imakedseye be sogoed.
Ar bemar ise-dakarmalad, igi Bab-Dummad ibmar-dummagan, ibmar-gegerdaklemalad bemarga imaksa. Degisoggu, be gatik e-nug-odummomar. Ar Bab-Dummad, be-Bab-Dummadid.
Be-babgan dulapaa-gakambe-mergu (70) Egipto-yarse nonigusmalad. Ar emigindi, Bab-Jehová, nibneggi-niisgwamar-naidyob bemar-omelosad.”
